name: less-annoying-crm
description: Reads Less Annoying CRM users, contacts, tasks, notes, and events through the Less Annoying CRM v2 API. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.
